mantra.line: The library already holds 1,537 setting items and 28 of the 74 wanted books are free right now — reading starts before any money moves.
TTRPG sourcebooks are the weighted target. Distill what's already on the shelf before chasing anything new.

paragraphs.name: Mission
paragraphs.plain: A mission is a task plus the reason for it. This one's reason is that a story's setting is only as deep as the books behind it, and the TTRPG sourcebooks are the fastest way to get there.

strand.last: The theme system's book hunt (BOLO 80) had just landed when Chief turned the same method on setting.

strand.you: You gave the order on 9/29 and ruled that you find the PDFs yourself; Claude never downloads books.
strand.next: You grab the free titles into Zotero or the drop folder, then say "rescan Zotero".
